veranderings.blok: Goed in die huis wat skade doen
veranderings.rede: Under a negative, 'of' makes clear that neither action is allowed; 'en' can read as 'not both together'.

veranderings.voor: Die deksel bly toe en die houer staan hoog
veranderings.na: Die deksel bly toe, en die houer staan hoog
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.

veranderings.blok: Medisyne help, maar net vir die regte mens
veranderings.voor: Medisyne word ook hoog en toe weggebêre
veranderings.na: Medisyne word ook toegemaak en hoog weggebêre
veranderings.rede: 'hoog en toe weggebêre' is awkward and 'toe' can be read as 'then'; same word count, same meaning.

veranderings.voor: begin dadelik spoel met baie skoon lopende water
veranderings.na: begin dadelik met baie skoon lopende water spoel
veranderings.rede: Standard Afrikaans puts the infinitive verb at the end after 'begin'.

veranderings.voor: teen die vel vas en die water spoel swak
veranderings.na: teen die vel vas, en die water spoel swak
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: two clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma.
'kom uit' can read as 'come out'; 'word uitgetrek' says plainly that the clothes are taken off, without naming who does it.

veranderings.voor: op jou eie hande en 'n grootmens moet dus help
veranderings.na: op jou eie hande, en 'n grootmens moet dus help
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: spoel dit dadelik met baie skoon water
veranderings.na: spoel die oog dadelik met baie skoon water
veranderings.rede: 'dit' can refer to 'iets' (the substance) rather than the eye; naming the eye removes the ambiguity.
Houses do not cook, and 'verhit' needs an object; 'huishoudings ... verwarm' is the natural usage, same word count.

veranderings.voor: Stap nooit terug in vir iets
veranderings.na: Gaan nooit weer in om iets te haal
veranderings.rede: 'terug in vir iets' copies English 'go back in for something'; the Afrikaans needs 'om iets te haal'.
A negative command takes 'moenie'; 'tel dit nie op nie' without a subject is not a correct imperative.

veranderings.voor: Moenie dit probeer blus of doodslaan nie
veranderings.na: Moenie die vuur probeer blus of doodslaan nie
veranderings.rede: 'dit' follows 'die veld' and reads as the veld; the thing not to put out is the fire.
'skoonmaakgoed' is a collective noun and does not take 'n'; 'skoonmaakmiddel' is the correct singular.

vlae.blok: Medisyne help, maar net vir die regte mens
vlae.teks: Medisyne is 'n middel wat siekte of pyn behandel, of keer dat 'n mens siek word.
vlae.rede: This sentence restates the protected word-for-word definition of 'medisyne' but drops 'help om ... te' (the protection's reason stresses that medicine HELPS). Not changed, because it touches a decided shared definition; a person or the writer should decide whether the study text must match the glossary wording.

vlae.teks: Die merk of plakker op 'n houer wat sê wat binne-in is.
vlae.rede: The protected entry withdrew 'die etiket sê wat' because a refilled bottle keeps its old label, which is this lesson's main example; this definition states that the label says what is inside. Not the withdrawn words exactly, so not a safety flag, but the meaning sits close to it and may contradict the lesson's own point. Content decision, not changed.

vlae.teks: Spoel die vel en die oog altwee ten minste vyftien tot twintig minute lank.
vlae.rede: 'ten minste' with a range ('vyftien tot twintig') is logically unclear: the minimum is one number. Fixing it needs the intended duration, which is a safety fact, so it is left for the writer.
